# montecarlo_microsoft_fabric_credentials (Data Source)

Microsoft Fabric credentials are the Entra ID service principal Monte Carlo signs in to a Fabric SQL endpoint with, stored for Microsoft Fabric connections to use. The client secret is never returned.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `credentials_id` (String) Id of the credentials, as returned when they are created or listed.

### Read-Only

- `app_client_id` (String) Client ID of the Entra ID app registration Monte Carlo signs in with.
- `connection_type` (String) The connection type the credentials are for, such as `snowflake`. Fixed once created.
- `created_time` (String) When the credentials were created.
- `db_name` (String) Warehouse or lakehouse to connect to.
- `host` (String) Hostname of the Fabric warehouse or lakehouse SQL analytics endpoint, as Fabric shows it under SQL connection string, such as `abc123.datawarehouse.fabric.microsoft.com`.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the credentials.
- `port` (Number) Port of the SQL endpoint. Fabric serves it on 1433.
- `storage_type` (String) Where the secret lives. Fixed once created.
- `tenant_id` (String) Microsoft Entra ID tenant the Fabric workspace belongs to.
